# MediaSimilarityFinder

Duplicate photo/video finder. Perceptual 64-bit pHash fingerprints (mirror + 4:3 / 1:1 / 9:16 crops), DTW video comparison with scene anchors and a duration prefilter, GPU-accelerated image hashing on CUDA, incremental SQLite index, and a real-time folder monitor with a Qt GUI.

## Repository layout

- The real source tree is `src_unpacked/`. The repo root (`C:\project` / `MediaSimilarityFinder`) also holds per-release artifacts (source zip, portable zip, binaries zip). Work happens inside `src_unpacked/`.
- `src_unpacked/src/` - engine, pure-C++ common layer (CUDA is a compile-time optional layer behind `gpu_backend.h`).
- `src_unpacked/gui/` - Qt widget application (`mainwindow.cpp` contains Korean UI string literals; edit with the Edit tool only).
- `src_unpacked/tests/` - CTest tests, named `msf_*_test`.
- `src_unpacked/scripts/` - `build_windows_cuda.ps1`, `build_windows_cpu.ps1`, `package_portable.ps1`.
- `src_unpacked/docs/` - per-build history (`build-history/<version>.ko.md`, `<version>.en.md`; must be written as a ko/en pair), architecture notes, `STRUCTURE.md`, and this file.
- `src_unpacked/AGENTS.md` - working rules (docs policy, build baseline 0.9.2.32, CUDA invariance, release procedure).

## Key entry points

- `src/media_search_engine.cpp` - `MediaSearchEngine::scan()` orchestrates listing, analysis, candidate indexing, similarity, live streaming of matches, persistence, and the GPU counter (`gpuImagesProcessed()`).
- `src/scan_pipeline.cpp` - duplicate detection. Image pairs via `bestMatch`/`thresholdFor`; video pairs run a duration gate then `temporal()` + `video_crop_similarity({threshold,8,2,2.0})`.
- `src/video_fingerprint.cpp` - `VideoFingerprintEngine::build()` (low-variance frame exclusion, scene-change detection, crop fingerprints), `video_similarity()`/`video_crop_similarity()` DTW with `sceneBonus`; versioned SQLite cache (`kCacheFormatVersion==4`).
- `src/video_sampling.cpp` - `make_sample_plan()` sample timestamps every 1..30 s by duration; `sampling_interval()`.
- `src/image_decoder.cpp` / `src/media_pipeline.cpp` / `src/gpu_backend.cpp` - image decode and CPU/CUDA hashing.
- `gui/mainwindow.cpp` - UI, status bar live GPU label (`updateGpuLabel()`), preview via shell thumbnail cache first (`shellThumbnailImage()`, `WTS_INCACHEONLY`), then decoders.

## Tests

`video_real_test` (same-file copy), `video_reencode_test` (transcode: mpeg4 160x90 -> libx264 128x72 crf28, expects similarity >= 85), `video_similarity_test`, `video_crop_similarity_test`, `video_cache_test`, `scan_pipeline_test`, `match_store_test`, `search_engine_test`, `database_test`, `monitor_*`, `candidate_*`, plus image/GPU/pipeline tests. Run: `ctest --test-dir build -C Release`.

## Build & release

- Build: `scripts/build_windows_cuda.ps1 -VcpkgRoot C:\src\vcpkg` (VS 2026 x64, project-local `vcpkg_installed`, `vcpkg.json` is the single dependency source).
- Smoke: `MediaSimilarityFinder.exe --smoke` (offscreen) and `--version`.
- Version bump files: `CMakeLists.txt`, `vcpkg.json`, `gui/main.cpp` (`kVersion`), `scripts/package_portable.ps1`, `src/index_manager.cpp`, `gui/mainwindow.cpp` (title/about/static texts).
- Release: docs ko/en pair + README tables + commit; force-`git add -f` the gitignored portable zip; tag at the portable-package commit; source zip from `git archive` then exclusions; push to `origin/main`.
